fixtures.name: openssl-1-0-1c
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The pinned version and legacy handshake prove fixture identity and reachability, not that a remote vulnerability probe will confirm Heartbleed.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The bundled nginx configuration and client/provider policy can prevent a raw vulnerability probe from completing even though the implementation is old.

fixtures.name: openssl-1-1-1m-patched
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A successful TLS 1.2 control handshake does not prove that every historical vulnerability is patched in every deployment.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: This control does not exercise the vulnerable TLS 1.0 nginx path or application-specific configuration.

fixtures.name: openssl-1-0-1c-ssl3-poodle
fixtures.expected: SSLv3 and TLS 1.0 negotiation with AES128-SHA; CR-TLS-POODLE-001=confirmed_vulnerable; CR-TLS-OPENSSL-ZERO-LENGTH-001=inconclusive
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The result confirms SSLv3 negotiation and the configured POODLE downgrade prerequisite; the 0-Length result remains inconclusive because no memory disclosure is observed.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The fixture does not exercise application traffic, browser behavior, or timing/oracle classification.

fixtures.name: openssl-1-1-1m-poodle-control
fixtures.expected: TLS 1.2 handshake succeeds and SSLv3 is not enabled; CR-TLS-POODLE-001=not_vulnerable
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A patched-version control proves only the configured listener posture, not every deployment using that library.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only protocol negotiation is tested; CBC padding behavior is not exercised.

fixtures.name: openssl-1-0-1c-padding
fixtures.false_positive_notes: An inconclusive timing result is not evidence that the pinned library is vulnerable; it only proves the scanner saw CBC support but no reliable oracle signal.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The probe cannot model AES-NI state, a man-in-the-middle position, or a stable remote timing distribution.

fixtures.name: openssl-1-1-1m-padding-control
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A GCM-only control proves this listener does not expose CBC to the scanner; it does not prove every cipher policy of the implementation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: No timing behavior is measured when CBC is unavailable.
